WITH RECURSIVE recursive_cte AS ( SELECT page_no, page_parent_no, page_no AS top_parent, page_name, 1 AS level, page_type FROM om_cloud_optimizer_page_tbl WHERE page_no = ${page_no} UNION ALL SELECT c.page_no, c.page_parent_no, p.top_parent, c.page_name, p.level + 1, c.page_type FROM om_cloud_optimizer_page_tbl c JOIN recursive_cte p ON c.page_no = p.page_parent_no ) SELECT page_name, LPAD('', level - 1, '--') || page_name AS indented_page_name, page_no, page_parent_no, top_parent AS top_parent_page_no, level, page_type FROM recursive_cte ORDER BY top_parent, page_no;

WITH RECURSIVE PageHierarchy AS ( SELECT page_no, page_url, page_name, page_type, page_parent_no, page_path, page_new_path, page_path_hash, cloud_no, site_no FROM om_cloud_optimizer_page_tbl ocopt WHERE page_parent_no = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.page_no, child.page_url, child.page_name, child.page_type, child.page_parent_no, child.page_path, child.page_new_path, child.page_path_hash, child.cloud_no, child.site_no from om_cloud_optimizer_page_tbl child INNER JOIN PageHierarchy parent ON child.page_parent_no = parent.page_no ) SELECT * FROM PageHierarchy ORDER BY page_name;
